Heartland Association of Fairs Festivals & Events Showcase

profile.description: Heartland Association of Fairs, Festivals & Events industry convention relationship. Adventure Zone attended the 2025 HAFFE convention and followed up with multiple fair/event contacts afterward. The 2026 convention is Nov. 19-21 in Minot, ND. The Sept. 1 showcase application is designed for live/video/strolling performance acts; Adventure Zone is a better fit for HAFFE's associate/vendor trade-show side.

notes.subject: Aug. 29 showcase decision — do not submit performance application
notes.body: Reviewed the June 27 HAFFE showcase invitation and current official convention information. The $100 showcase application is for a 15-minute live performance, 5-minute video performance, or 15-minute strolling act. Adventure Zone does not fit that performance-showcase format well. HAFFE explicitly accepts appropriate support businesses as associate members, and the 2026 convention schedule includes associate visits and vendor setup. Decision: do not spend $100 on the performance showcase application. Preserve HAFFE as a valuable convention relationship and use the associate/vendor trade-show route instead.

followUps.label: HAFFE — review associate/vendor registration
followUps.reason: Skip the performance showcase. Review the 2026 associate registration/trade-show options and secure an appropriate convention presence if the booth/registration terms make sense.
